title: Sugreeva
desc: Sugreeva's son needs urgent heart surgery, but unable to afford it he takes a drastic step by hijacking the hospital.

title: Anaganaga Oka Raju
desc: In vibrant Gaurapuram, quirky Raju meets spirited Charulatha, sparking events. Their tale centers on a grand wedding, blending humor and family celebrations in this festive story.

title: Gaalipata 2
desc: Three college friends reunite after several years to help their ailing teacher and find a chance to rebuild their love lives.

title: Ganeshana Maduve
desc: Ganesha lives happily in a complex owned by Ramanamurthy. Things take a turn when he falls in love with Adilakshmi, the youngest daughter of Ramanamurthy who sings under the pseudonym Shruti.
